Results.ReviewText: Bought the Spirit II E-310 gas grill two month ago after having an old Spirit Weber gas grill for 12 years.  Not sure what the designers were thinking for several "take away" reasons:1) taking away the wheels on the left side was a big mistake.  To make that mistake worse, they removed the wheels on the same side as the retractable side shelf. In order to move the grill around, you have to lift up on the weaker of the two shelves, which is dangerous,  2) taking away the enclosed shelf below. They removed the closable doors, which exposes much needed storage space to the elements, 3) the hood is made out of a much cheaper/lighter metal. On the other hand, the ignition system is far superior to the old side push button.  I also appreciate the increase in BTU's. I'm saying I'd recommend this grill to a friend because it's a Weber but I'm not sure that I would with all these changes that don't make sense for the griller - they just seem to be an effort to cut costs.
Results.Title: Add Ons and Take Aways

Results.ReviewText:
I had a Spirit 210 from years ago.  Comparing this Spirit 310 to it, I can see major design differences.  The grill components appear cheaper.  The stainless steel used isn't high quality.  The absolute worst part of the grill is the design of how the grilling enclosure sits within the frame.  The grill is bolted in to the frame at the front but nothing in the back.  As a result the back of the grilling compartment can move around within the frame, left or right.  This is a problem because when the lid is opened, the back of the lid scrapes the frame unless it is sitting perfectly in the center.  The previous Spirit 210 I had sat above the frame.  So the hinge point didn't matter.

Despite the major design flaw and the lesser quality steel, the grill functions very well.  Heat is evenly distributed.

If I had realized what I was buying I may have chosen a different grill.  I'm not too worried about lesser quality components as Weber in the past has always stood behind their products.  If something rusts out, they generally just replace it for free if you call them up.  Standing behind their product counts for a lot.
Results.Title: Bad Design

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this grill in March 2018. It works well for a family of 4. I use it 3-4 times a week. Some things are great about it, other things not so great. I bought the white color. I usually don't get the temperature past 500 degrees to cook, so over the past few months a few burn marks have started showing through the white paint. It doesn't affect the grills performance at all, but it's just not very appealing for a $500 grill.
I believe the shelf on the left side of the grill is a design flaw as well. It's meant to lift up and fold over for a more compact look when it's being stored away, but it's also the shelf you have to lift when you want to move your grill. It tends to come out of its locking mechanisms and fall out of your hands.
The scale for the propane tank is extremely useless. Mine doesn't even read close to what's actually in the tank. It constantly reads full. Overall it's a pretty decent grill. If I had to go back and re-do everything, i think I'd purchase the black model. But for the money it's a decent product.
Results.Title: Decent little grill, nothing to write home about.

My Weber E-310 has opened my eyes to what I have been missing for all the years I was using a grill made by someone other than Weber. I had lost interest in grilling because of the difficulty in getting good results with my old grill.

The Weber E-310  heats up very quickly and easily reaches the proper temperature to get the perfect sear on the meat. The heat is very even over the entire grilling area and the controls allow for fine control over the temperature.

The propane tank scale is a very nice feature. No more pulling out the tank and trying to guess how much gas is left and running out of gas in the middle of grilling the food when I guessed wrong.

Needless to say, I am grilling every chance I get now, and so far, the meat has been perfect.

I installed my old rotisserie unit on the new grill, after modifying the bracket, and it works fairly well. It would work even better if the inside height were a little deeper. The depth allows for a small chicken to be cooked on the rotisserie . I also purchased a wire basket , so that I can cook chicken and vegetables on the rotisserie bar.
Results.Title: Comments on a Weber Spirit 11 E 310 gas grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I've only used the grill a few times, but so far it works very well. I love how easily it ignites, and it grill evenly. I bought the grill with the red cover, which looks great. The knobs have a strip of red, which picks up the color of the cover, giving the grill a very high end appearance. 

The grill heats up quickly and the food cooks faster than my prior grill, so if you buy this grill, be careful to watch the food, so it doesn't burn.
Results.Title: Works well.

Results.ReviewText: I bought it because Americas test kitchen rated it (or rather its processor) very highly.  I've used Webber grills for 60 years and this one replaces my 21 year old Genesis 1000.  I love the cast iron grates and the even cooking, but not the inconvenient, inaccurate and hard to see fuel gauge.  The lid is warped enough that it rests on only one corner when closed.  It cost $50 less than my Genesis did in 1997 and the cost cutting is obvious to me.  I'm a bit sorry I didn't just buy cast iron grates for the Genesis.
Results.Title: Performs well but cost cutting apparent

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I replaced a 25 yo Weber 22" charcoal grill with the Spirit II and am glad I did. First, I find the results to be equal or superior to the charcoal grill; without the bags of charcoal, 20 minute heat-up and the accumulation of ash. Second, assembly was easy with excellent instructions; and fit and finish are great.
Results.Title: Just what I wanted: Quality and Performance

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I got this just 3 weeks ago and I've used it 7 times already!!!  It heats up fast and got over 650 degrees.  Great for searing!!!  I've had different Weber grills over the last few years, mostly charcoal.  I loved the flavor and aroma, especially when adding hickory wood.  But, I got tired of the mess with ashes, etc.  I tried the Weber Q 1200 which I also liked, but I felt it didn't get hot enough. It would be great for those needing a portable grill. I didn't want to spend the big bucks on a larger Weber, but when I found this new Spirit II E-310, I had to try it. It is amazing. Very easy and fast to use.  Ignites on first click. Grates clean up easily. Temp controls work well.  Well worth the money.  Food comes out great and has a great flavor. I just wish I would have gotten one sooner.  I've done burgers, sausage, steaks, pork roasts, and even an eight pound turkey breast.  Everything came out great!!!
Results.Title: Fantastic grill

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I used it for the first time this past weekend and it worked like a charm. Very easy to operate and cooked burgers perfectly.
Results.Title: Very usable and efficient.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill as a scratch and dent from Lowe's. I paid $80 for it with manifold damage and missing grates. I called weber and told them what I needed and they sent me a brand new manifold w/knobs and new grates for $125. I installed the new parts, hooked up the gas tank and it fired right up. The grates hold heat really well and clean very easily. The burners cook evenly all over no matter where my food is on the grates. This really is a great grill and for the money I have in it ($205) it's just that much better.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
